familyDefinition: Every a priori catalog rule on every authority x claim cell with nScored >= 10 and chanceRate > 0. One PISA unit-rate numeric row with chanceRate 0 was excluded as a degenerate test. Pre-registered witness bar is lower 95% bootstrap CI above recorded chanceRate and n >= 10. Family-wise tests are one-sided binomial p-values H1: rate > chanceRate, Holm and Bonferroni at alpha=0.05.
